gap:logistic_regression_task.statement: Need to fit logistic regression with exact conventions: 5-fold contiguous CV, full-batch GD (200 iter, lr=0.1), clipped logits [-30,30], and evaluate L2 strength, interaction terms, and model compression.

claim:lambda_optimization.statement: Among L2 strengths [0.0, 0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0], lambda=0.1 achieves the lowest 5-fold CV Brier score (0.207077) with improvement of 0.0089 over baseline (lambda=0, Brier=0.215977).

claim:interaction_terms.statement: Adding interaction terms (x0*x1, x1*x2, x2*x3, x0*x3) to the logistic model with lambda=0.1 provides significant improvement. Paired t-test yields t-statistic of 3.912 (p=0.017), exceeding the threshold of 2.0, indicating interaction terms help.

claim:compression_config.statement: Among compression configurations (sparsity: 20/40/60%, bits: 4/8), sparsity20_bits4 retains the most dense-model Brier performance with retention rate of 0.9992, requiring only minimal precision loss.
